home_lgu_cta_subtitle: Birth certificates, business permits and barangay concerns go to your city or municipal hall. The Province runs provincial hospitals, roads, social welfare and more. Find the right office first.
home_map_description: Interactive map of the Province of Bukidnon in Northern Mindanao. The marker shows the Provincial Capitol in Malaybalay City, at about 8.1575°N, 125.1278°E.
home_history_precolonial: The highlands are home to the Bukidnon, Higaonon, Talaandig, Manobo, Matigsalug, Tigwahanon and Umayamnon peoples, the seven tribes of Bukidnon.
home_history_1850s: Under Spanish rule, the area becomes part of the province of Misamis.
home_history_1907: Act No. 1693 creates the province of Agusan with Bukidnon as a sub-province. Malaybalay becomes its capital.
home_history_1917: Act No. 2711 makes Bukidnon a regular province on 10 March, now celebrated as the province's founding anniversary.
home_history_1977: The provincial government holds the first organized Kaamulan Festival, a gathering of the seven tribes.
home_history_cityhood: Malaybalay becomes a city in 1998 (Republic Act No. 8490), followed by Valencia in 2001.
home_history_2012: Republic Act No. 10184 divides Bukidnon into four congressional districts, in effect from the 2013 elections.
home_history_card_tribes: Kaamulan comes from the Binukid word "amul", to gather. The festival brings the seven tribes to Malaybalay around the 10 March founding anniversary.
home_history_card_highlands: Mount Dulang-dulang in the Kitanglad Range, about 2,938 meters high, is the second highest peak in the Philippines. Bukidnon's plateau farms earn it the name "food basket of Mindanao".
home_volunteer_subtitle: BetterBukidnon.org is a civic project, not an official government website.

seo_home_description: BetterBukidnon.org is a volunteer civic portal for the Province of Bukidnon: provincial services, officials, emergency hotlines, statistics and public information in English, Filipino and Cebuano.
seo_projects_description: Community-built tools for the people of Bukidnon: budget, SALN and infrastructure transparency portals and other BetterBukidnon projects.
seo_services_description: Directory of services in the Province of Bukidnon: provincial offices, and where to go in your city or municipality for certificates, permits, taxes, health, social welfare and more. A volunteer-run guide.
seo_government_description: Provincial Government of Bukidnon: Governor, Vice Governor, Sangguniang Panlalawigan, provincial offices, the four legislative districts, and the 2 cities and 20 municipalities of Bukidnon.
seo_officials_description: Governor Rogelio Neil P. Roque, Vice Governor Clive D. Quiño, the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (Provincial Board), and the four district representatives of the Province of Bukidnon, term 2025–2028.
seo_statistics_description: Bukidnon statistics: 2024 population of 1,601,902, land area of 10,498.59 km², 2 cities, 20 municipalities and 464 barangays, with 2020 census figures for every city and municipality and each legislative district.
seo_legislative_description: Access legislative documents, ordinances, and resolutions of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Bukidnon. Browse provincial laws and legislative records from LGU Bukidnon.
seo_ordinances_description: Browse provincial ordinances enacted by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Bukidnon. Access local laws, regulations, and legislative documents from LGU Bukidnon.
seo_resolutions_description: Browse resolutions passed by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Bukidnon. Access provincial resolutions, council decisions, and legislative records from LGU Bukidnon.
seo_budget_description: View the provincial budget and financial transparency reports of Bukidnon. Access public funds data, budget breakdown, expenditures, and financial statements from LGU Bukidnon.
seo_news_description: Latest news, updates, and announcements from LGU Bukidnon. Stay informed about provincial programs, events, and community developments.
seo_contact_description: Contact the Provincial Government of Bukidnon: Capitol address in Malaybalay City, office hours, telephone directory of provincial offices, and emergency hotlines (911, PDRRMD, police, fire, PHO, PSWDO).
seo_faq_description: Frequently asked questions about Bukidnon provincial services, procedures, requirements, and how to access LGU Bukidnon programs. Get answers to common questions.
